test_optimizer_redundant_reshape: test that the optimizer skips redundant consecutive reshape operations on a given input shape
test_optimizer_nonredundant_reshape: test that the optimizer retains non-redundant reshape operations separated by a transpose
test_optimizer_noop_reshape: test that the optimizer removes a no-op reshape when the target shape matches the input shape
test_optimizer_noop_after_transpose: test that the optimizer skips a no-op reshape that follows a transpose operation
test_optimizer_noop_after_broadcast: test that the optimizer skips a no-op reshape that follows a broadcast operation
